resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.languages: English and Spanish (site states text and chat are available in Spanish)
resources.description: Call, text or chat with a trained crisis counselor about suicidal thoughts, emotional distress or any mental health crisis.
resources.notes: Chat at chat.988lifeline.org. Site does not state which languages phone calls cover.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text with a volunteer crisis counselor for support during a crisis or any hard moment.
resources.notes: Site says carrier message and data rates may apply.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.languages: English and Spanish by phone; text service is English only
resources.description: Treatment referral and information service for mental health conditions and substance use, for individuals and families.
resources.notes: TTY 1-800-487-4889. Site describes the referral service as free of charge.

resources.name: Naseeha Mental Health Helpline
resources.description: Free peer support helpline run by Naseeha, open around the clock for people who want someone to talk to.
resources.notes: Phone matches on home page and helpline page. Page title mentions a textline but no text number was found, so text is blank. Languages not stated.

resources.name: The Trevor Project
resources.description: Crisis counselors reachable by phone, text or online chat for LGBTQ+ young people.
resources.notes: TTY 1-866-803-3699. Chat on the get-help page. Languages not listed.

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.description: Confidential support by phone, text or chat for veterans, service members and their families in crisis.
resources.notes: Online chat available. Spanish version of site exists; call languages not stated.

resources.name: StrongHearts Native Helpline
resources.description: Confidential helpline for Native Americans and Alaska Natives affected by domestic, dating or sexual violence.
resources.notes: Page states advocates offer services at no cost. This is a domestic and sexual violence helpline, not a general mental health line. Languages not stated.

resources.name: Disaster Distress Helpline
resources.cost: Free (toll-free; standard text rates may apply)
resources.languages: Over 100 languages via interpretation; Spanish: press 2
resources.description: Crisis counseling by phone or text for people distressed by a disaster, including natural and human-caused events.
resources.notes: Site says less common languages may require a scheduled callback. Available to US residents and territories.

resources.name: Trans Lifeline
resources.hours: Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 9 PM Eastern (10 AM to 6 PM Pacific)
resources.description: Peer support hotline for trans and questioning people, answered by phone on weekdays.
resources.notes: Added candidate. Cost not stated on page. Not 24/7; site warns waits may be longer when volume is high. Description audience wording not quoted from page.

resources.name: Muslim Therapist Directory
resources.description: Searchable directory of Muslim mental health professionals, with filters for gender, sect, issue, modality and location.
resources.notes: Site says Powered by Ruh and lists 720+ professionals in 19 countries. Fetch returned a security-check message, so page may not have fully loaded. No cost or language information found. Linked from the IMMH site.

resources.name: Institute for Muslim Mental Health
resources.description: Research, training and resources on Muslim American mental health, with a link to the Muslim Therapist Directory.
resources.notes: Phone omitted: the site footer lists 1-800-273-TALK (8255), which is the retired 988 predecessor number and should not be published. Site is current (2026 events).

resources.name: Maristan
resources.description: Clinic offering therapy for anxiety, depression, couples, families, children, trauma and identity, plus chaplaincy and training programs.
resources.notes: Office phone (510) 380-7229 and info@maristan.org listed, but it is an office line not a crisis line, so left out. Site directs crisis to 988 and emergencies to 911. Fees, languages and states served not stated; booking is by form. Whether service is truly national was not confirmed.

resources.name: Khalil Center
resources.cost: Insurance accepted; sliding scale financial assistance
resources.description: Faith-based counseling, psychiatry, psychological assessments and religious consultation for Muslim clients.
resources.notes: Fees page lists income-based sliding scale charts for Illinois, California, New York and Toronto, and says psychiatry is not accepting out-of-state clients. Telehealth and states served not stated, so 'National' is unconfirmed. Review before listing as national.

resources.name: Ruh Care
resources.cost: $120 to $200 per session; sliding scale assistance for those without insurance
resources.languages: ASL, Arabic, Bangla, Creole, English, Farsi, French, German, Harari, Hindi, Malayalam, Pashto, Punjabi, Rohingya, Sindhi, Somali, Tamil, Urdu, Wolof
resources.description: Online therapy by phone or video with licensed Muslim therapists, for individuals, couples, children and families.
resources.notes: Phone omitted: only number shown is 1-416-639-5993, a Canadian area code. Site says services are fully online and covered by most major insurers but lists no US states, so state coverage is unconfirmed.

resources.name: The Family & Youth Institute
resources.description: National nonprofit offering a resource hub on Muslim American mental health, covering stigma, suicide, grief, therapy, parenting and youth.
resources.notes: Resource hub exists (thefyi.org/resourcehub/ appeared in search results; not separately opened). Cost not stated.

resources.name: Muslim Mental Health and Islamic Psychology Lab (Stanford)
resources.description: Stanford Medicine research lab publishing studies, suicide response guidance and trainings on Islamic psychology and Muslim mental health.
resources.notes: Site has no direct clinical service for the public. Search snippets mention a Starter Kit and free MMHI sessions at partner campuses; not confirmed on the page opened. Lab name on page may be 'Muslims and Mental Health Lab'.

resources.name: Muslim Mental Health Consortium (Michigan State University)
resources.description: Hosts the annual Muslim Mental Health Conference and related resources for practitioners, faith leaders and community members.
resources.notes: Added candidate (Michigan connection). Site says it is under construction. Fees not stated.

resources.name: Black Mental Health Alliance
resources.description: Nonprofit offering culturally relevant behavioral health programs, resources and support for Black communities.
resources.notes: No therapist directory found on the landing page. No phone or cost stated. Site is current (2026 references). Whether programs are national was not confirmed.

resources.name: BEAM
resources.description: Healing justice organization with a Black Virtual Wellness Directory, grants, trainings and monthly healing circles.
resources.notes: Directory is at wellness.beam.community (not separately opened). Cost not stated. Site is active (2026 events).

resources.name: Therapy for Black Girls
resources.description: Directory of culturally responsive therapists at providers.therapyforblackgirls.com, plus a podcast and blog.
resources.notes: Cost not stated. Site is active (posts dated Nov 2026).

resources.name: Latinx Therapy
resources.cost: Sliding scale and private pay (varies by provider)
resources.languages: English and Spanish; some providers also Spanglish
resources.description: Directory of verified mental health providers serving Latino and Latinx people, with psychiatrist and immigration evaluation listings.
resources.notes: Site lists 1,300+ providers across 50 states. Footer shows 2025 copyright; site appears active. Site advises screening providers.

resources.name: Asian Mental Health Collective
resources.cost: Therapy Fund is free (16 sessions over six months, by application); directory cost not stated
resources.description: Directory of 3,000+ Asian therapists, a Free Therapy Fund by application, and virtual support groups.
resources.notes: Site active (events Nov 2026). Therapy Fund spots are limited. Languages not listed.

resources.name: South Asian Mental Health Initiative and Network (SAMHIN)
resources.description: Non-emergency helpline, support groups and a provider directory for South Asian communities in the US.
resources.notes: Helpline is explicitly non-emergency; site links to 988 for crisis. Provider directory registration is free for providers. Cost to callers and languages not stated. Phone appears in two places on the page with the same number.

resources.name: The Steve Fund
resources.description: Nonprofit supporting young people in underserved communities, with workshops, a knowledge center and a crisis text line.
resources.notes: Site shows a website redesign in progress banner. Cost not stated. Text keyword uses the shared Crisis Text Line number 741741.

resources.name: We R Native
resources.description: Health and wellness resource for Native youth, with articles, an Ask Your Relative question service and text message programs.
resources.notes: www.wernative.org redirects to wernative.npaihb.org (Northwest Portland Area Indian Health Board). No crisis number found on the page beyond 988 mention; text programs say message and data rates may apply. Footer shows mixed copyright years.

resources.name: National Queer and Trans Therapists of Color Network
resources.description: National directory of queer and trans therapists of color, plus a practitioner membership program and community resources.
resources.notes: Cost not stated. Donations go through fiscal sponsor Possibility Labs.

resources.name: Open Path Collective
resources.cost: Low-cost sessions set by therapist plus a one-time membership fee
resources.description: Directory of therapists offering reduced-rate sessions to members who pay a one-time membership fee.
resources.notes: Fetched fee text was garbled with both old and new figures and USD/CAD mixed (sessions roughly $40 to $90, membership $65 to $89). Exact current US amounts not confirmed, so dollar figures left out. Verify on site.

resources.name: Psychology Today Therapist Finder
resources.description: Searchable directory of therapists by location, concern and specialty.
resources.notes: Faith and language filters were NOT confirmed on the pages opened (a More Search Options link exists). Do not claim those filters without checking. Cost to search not stated.

dropped.name: NAMI HelpLine
dropped.reason: nami.org returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so it could not be opened. Search snippets of nami.org suggest 1-800-950-NAMI (6264), Mon to Fri 10 AM to 10 PM ET, and two different text keywords (NAMI vs HELPLINE to 62640). Worth a manual check; it is not a crisis line.

dropped.name: Amala Muslim Youth Hopeline
dropped.reason: amala.org redirects to a domain-for-sale page; amala.mas-ssf.org does not resolve; mas-ssf.org home page lists no hotline number. Sources conflict on hours (several different schedules). Unconfirmed number from third parties: 855-95-AMALA (855-952-6252). Verify with MAS-SSF (mas-ssf.org/amala) directly.

dropped.name: Muslim Wellness Foundation
dropped.reason: muslimwellnessfoundation.org returned empty content and no official site could be found by search; only a Benevity charity listing.

dropped.name: Yaqeen Institute mental health hub
dropped.reason: yaqeeninstitute.org/mental-health returned 404; no dedicated hub confirmed.

dropped.name: MannMukti
dropped.reason: mannmukti.org shows a 2021 copyright, expired fellowship dates and a retired 1-800-273-8255 number; activity not confirmed. www.mannmukti.com does not resolve.

dropped.name: Inclusive Therapists
dropped.reason: inclusivetherapists.com returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch. Search results indicate a sliding scale filter and directory exist, but the site itself could not be opened.

dropped.name: Refuat Hanefesh
dropped.reason: refuathanefesh.org redirects to an unrelated site (majestkids.com), so the official site could not be reached.
